unique_value: golden refusal cases preserve expected refusal decisions and structured reason semantics
mutation-stable refusal invariants are exercised through a bounded deterministic argument mutation corpus
cross-version behavior is classified explicitly so refusal loss, reason drift, and category drift cannot hide behind aggregate pass rates
safety-regression evidence is replayable and fingerprinted rather than anecdotal

capability_contribution.ownership: This repository remains the owning Anthropic-specialist implementation; extraction preserves identity and lineage.

next_evolution: Bind golden-case corpus lineage, minimize discovered counterexamples into durable regression vectors, and sign/version baseline manifests so cross-version comparisons can prove exactly which corpus and taxonomy were authoritative.
nonclaims: mutation coverage is bounded rather than exhaustive
the harness evaluates supplied decision functions rather than independently proving production model behavior
